result.summary: Found 2 minor issues related to inconsistent badge styling and heart icon contrast on the food delivery app home screen.

issues.description: The promotional badge on the pizza card reads '-0%' which appears to be a broken or placeholder discount value, as a 0% discount is meaningless to display.
issues.suggestion: Replace with a valid discount value or remove the badge if no discount applies.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon styling is inconsistent between cards. On the ramen card it appears as a white filled circle with dark outline, while on the pizza card it appears as a dark filled circle, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart/favorite icon background and styling across all restaurant cards.
